title: 八十七蚊
mood: petty, furious and funny about money
subject: chasing four friends since March for the eighty-seven dollars each still owed from a birthday karaoke room you paid for
caption: Cantonese pop-punk in the fast 2000s pop-punk style. Two overdriven guitars playing palm-muted eighth-note power chords in the verses that open into ringing chords in the chorus; an octave lead-guitar riff between lines; a pick-played bass locked to the kick; double-time snare beats with a crash on every bar of the chorus, and a half-time breakdown on bass and floor tom before the last chorus. Loud, tight and live-sounding, guitars wide left and right, lead voice and gang shouts forward. Young male voice, bright and slightly nasal, singing fast syllabic lines, a gang of friends shouting the 'pay me back' answers written in the lyrics, the last chorus half-shouted. 180 BPM, E major. Petty, furious and funny about eighty-seven dollars. No mid-tempo arena rock, no metal growls, no ballad section, no synths, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Verse]
三月尾 阿Ken生日 K房唱到兩點
埋單每人八十七 我話我畀住先
個個話 好兄弟 返到屋企即刻轉
而家十月 我仲喺度等

[Pre-Chorus]
我send咗PayMe 你哋已讀
已讀 已讀 已讀 已讀

[Chorus]
八十七蚊 八十七蚊
唔係錢嘅問題 係原則問題
八十七蚊 八十七蚊
還錢！ 還錢！ 你哋仲記唔記得

[Verse]
阿Ken換咗新電話 日日影相上IG
阿明去咗日本 四日三夜食和牛
阿詩話下個月出糧 講咗六個月
阿Bo block咗我 我都唔知點解

[Pre-Chorus]
我再send多次 加埋個笑臉
笑臉 笑臉 笑到我塊面都僵

[Chorus]
八十七蚊 八十七蚊
唔係錢嘅問題 係原則問題
八十七蚊 八十七蚊
還錢！ 還錢！ 夠我食兩碗車仔麵

[Bridge]
我知 我知 我好小器
但係下個禮拜 到我生日
今次 邊個 畀住先

[Chorus]
八十七蚊 八十七蚊
唔係錢嘅問題 係原則問題
八十七蚊 八十七蚊
還錢！ 還錢！ 唔還唔使嚟我生日

[Outro]
叮 有人轉咗數
阿詩 轉咗八十六
